definitions.claim_to_native_reservation_ms: durable claim until GX funding reservation for same native Turn, includes native thread materialization
definitions.cold_dispatch_start_to_first_writer_ms: first admitted Root dispatch per Run through the first outer GX writer under the same Task identity. Includes lazy public-driver native/worker tool initialization; no production timer separates these inside this interval.
definitions.eligible_before_own_dispatch_outside_sib: eligible to start of own follow-on dispatch, excluding any overlapping synchronous sibling Run dispatches
definitions.eligible_wait_outside_sibling_dispatch_m: eligible interval with observed synchronous other-Run dispatch overlap subtracted; other work or waits inside this residual are not classified
definitions.eligible_wait_overlapping_sibling_dispat: union of actually timed dispatch intervals on the other Run of the same single-coordinator workspace while the measured claim was eligible
definitions.existing_lease_dispatch: identity-matched dispatch on an already live original lease; count separately from official resume-prefixed turn deliveries
definitions.follow_on_own_dispatch_start_to_claim_ms: admitted follow-on dispatch start (or eligibility if later) to the durable claim, including actual GX claim preparation
definitions.follow_on_preclaim_outside_writer_ms: remaining observed own preclaim interval after excluding that clipped writer union; includes Python, other IO, metric emissions and timing uncertainty
definitions.follow_on_preclaim_writer_ms: union of same-Task outer GX writer time clipped to follow-on dispatch start through claim, including lock acquisition. Metrics identify no individual SQL/Python call. The metric end timestamp is emitted after transaction-end callbacks, which can offset reconstruction; claim event is persisted to milliseconds.
definitions.native_reservation_to_official_start_ms: GX budget reservation to Codex official task_started message; accurate to persisted millisecond precision
definitions.new_claim: dispatch interval containing the durable READY to CLAIMED edge plus matching original lease; telemetry end minus elapsed reconstructs start
definitions.official_start_to_dispatch_return_ms: official task_started to GX dispatch timer end; native start and receipt processing run asynchronously
definitions.ready_and_previous_team_slot_released_to: noninitial same-Team claim minus the later of this READY timestamp and the prior Task lease release/native terminal/budget settlement; each Team has one slot and only one other single-slot Team shares its two-slot workspace
definitions.ready_unadmitted: task remained READY at midpoint before its actual claim; return reason unavailable from real GX metrics; control timers record HoldActive explicitly
definitions.standardization: nearest weighted empirical p95 retaining same operation-specific duration samples, replacing only operation frequencies; missing stratum yields null
